blindDescriptions.System A: visionOS Messages + FaceTime Audio (visionOS 26 / iOS 26 spatial): Centered frosted glass over live passthrough world (saturate 1.6 blur 28-34 + rim light, not synthetic gradient). Inbox shows header 'Messages' 22/800 -0.03 SF Pro Display 800 + single count pill 11/700 ink-80 0.07 outline, subtitle is single line 11/600 ink-60 with time tabular only — no literal token strings. Filter is one pill 28h 'Inbox · 5' + 'Unread' count 6/700, not two competing primaries. Thread list shows 3 peeking cards max at rest with depth scale 0.96 + blur falloff, single focal card at a time (others dim to 0.42, focused scales 1.02 + 2.5px stroke-focus + 22px bloom, dwell 350ms prism-ease interruptible). Each card is 18r glass (saturate 1.4 blur22 + stroke 0.12 + sheen + 2-layer shadow 40/90), avatar 40r 13 circle with live presence dot only when live, name 15/600 ink-100, time 11 tabular ink-60 right-aligned, preview 13/400 ink-80 1-line clamp 1.38 leading, meta 11/600 ink-60, unread dot 8 not numbered badge + 1px call glyph subtle not 30px pill competing. Bottom is not persistent hintbar; hints dim to 0.38 until gaze near. Tap opens conversation sheet var(--mat-sheet) 0.82 blur34 that slides 260ms prism-ease interruptible by look-away reverse 180ms: header back 34 clean, status 'Active now' 11/600 with single green pulse, Call pill 32 gradient only one primary, transcript shows at most one exchange peeking with bubbles 14/500 max 72% width (recv rgba255,255,255 0.08 + 1px stroke 0.10, sent gradient accent->accent-strong 18r with bottom 6r chir tail), photo bubble is true 12MP thumbnail with glass cap, not flat red gradient. Composer is single input 36r 14/400 with one primary chip max and voice glyph 11/600, not 4 competing chips 28h. Call is centered 26r glass card with 96 avatar + persistent 16px accent bloom + single waveform line tied to RMS (not 7 random bars), duration 30 tabular 800 centered, controls 48/64 with 4px gap and clear mute red state; motion is 260ms prism-ease, no infinite ringPulse 1.8s or livePulse 1.4s decorative; reduced-motion collapses to 160ms crossfade. Edge states are native sheets over passthrough with one 64 illustration + one CTA. At arm's length <1s glance: title -> first preview -> badge -> done. Typography 3 sizes max per card (22/15/13/11), SF Pro Text 0.01 tracking, tabular only for time.

biggestGap: Typography + Glanceability leak — literal token string 'tabular' shipped as user-facing content in 6 places: expected visionOS optical hierarchy (SF Pro 22/14/13/11, tabular tabular-nums only via font-variant-numeric, subtitle reads '5 threads · 11:49 AM', group head reads 'Today 2' + hairline divider, offline reads 'Queued · 2 waiting' + time tabular, never literal). Got components/10-messages/index.html:703 `subtitle.innerHTML = ... `${threads.length} threads · tabular` ... `${nowStr}` -> renders '5 threads · tabular 11:49 AM' visible reviews/probe-10-edge/01-normal-stage.png top 94px; :760 `head.innerHTML = ... TABULAR` -> 'TABULAR' right-aligned ink-40 visible same screenshot; :865 composer `tabular 9:44` pill; :1164 `Call · 00:13 · tabular` preview leak after call (04-call-ended-conv-stage.png); :1260 empty `Humane empty · tabular times · 600×600`; :1342 offline `Queued · tabular · 2 waiting`. visionOS would never ship variable names; this forces ~1.8s re-parse (is 'tabular' a filter? mode?). Fix: delete all literal 'tabular'/'TABULAR' strings, keep class="tabular" for tabular-nums styling only, limit hintbar to one phrase, group head to label+count+line only.

gaps.glanceability: Expected <1s extraction: visionOS shows title + one line preview + single dot unread + one call glyph subtle; Got inbox needs ~2.2s: header 22 title + 11 pill 3 unread + subtitle literal tabular + two filter pills + Today 2 + TABULAR label + 5 cards each with name 14 + preview 13 1-line clamp but ellipsis truncates mid-word ('World layer looks great!' cut to 'World layer looks great!' vs 'World layer looks great!' same but bottom card cut off 50% at stage bottom), badge 2/1 blue gradient + 30px call button competing same row, plus hintbar 3 instructions 10 uppercase at bottom 12px competing for glance. visionOS would peek 2-3 cards max with depth, not 5 clipped.
gaps.focusDiscipline: Expected exactly one obvious focal element per moment with unmistakable halo (10px dot + 3px halo + 2.5px stroke-focus + 22px bloom + 350ms dwell prism-ease, others dim to 0.38): visionOS single hero card or shutter. Got 20 focusables (14 in-stage + 6 chips outside) with nested interactive inside interactive: each .thread-card [data-focusable] contains .thread-call button [data-focusable] 30px = competing hit targets inside same card (components/10-messages/index.html:774-803). At rest reviews/probe-10-edge/01-normal-stage.png zero elements dimmed, 5 cards equal mat-raised+blur22 intensity, +New primary 28h gradient same weight as unread badges, gaze-focus only via :hover translateY -1 / scale 1.015 transient not idle halo (probe 08-hover-focus-stage.png shows no bloom), call overlay at 03-call-active-stage.png cursor top-right not on End 64 despite code focus endBtn. Result focus discipline fails severe. Fix: remove nested call buttons from card hit area (make swipe or long-press), dim non-focused cards to 0.42, make gaze-focus persistent bloom default.
gaps.materialHonesty: Expected scrim reads as glass over live world (saturate 1.6 blur28 rim light + feathered shadow 40/90 on passthrough): visionOS. Got stage synthetic double-radial #060a10 0.76 wash (line 9-13) opaque charcoal, thread-card mat-raised 0.88-0.92 blur22 reads as dark opaque panel not translucent glass; conv-sheet mat-sheet 0.96-0.97 blur34 almost opaque (line 255-256) slides over inbox but not glass-over-world; call-card same 0.88-0.92. Horizon flat #1e1e1e no blur. Fix: lower sheet opacity to 0.82, use live world video texture if available, reduce shadow 24/56 to hairline + 18/44 only.
gaps.motion: Expected 200-320ms prism-ease cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1) interruptible, no infinite decorative cost: visionOS 260ms spring reverse 180ms on look-away. Got rise-in 260ms correct for header/filter/group (lines 76/108/138) but sheet-in 300ms borderline + livePulse 1.4s infinite (line 464), ringPulse 1.8s infinite (484), wavePulse 260ms infinite alternate + JS jitter 140ms random (1096-1102), shimmer 1.2s linear infinite (570), all decorative attention cost during call when user needs calm; none interruptible via look-away (CSS animations not WAAPI interruptible, close uses WAAPI but open uses CSS). Banner-in 380ms over spec. Fix: remove infinite ringPulse/livePulse, tie wave to actual RMS with pause when muted, clamp all to 260ms max and WAAPI with reverse.
gaps.typography: Expected SF-Pro-class 3 sizes max per card (22/15/13/11), tabular-nums via class only, tracking -0.015: visionOS. Got 6 distinct sizes stage [10,11,13,14,22,30] vs spec 3 per card; card itself 11,13,14 but 13/14 diff 1px weak hierarchy (name 14/700 vs preview 13/500 barely distinct at arm length). Literal 'tabular' leaks in 6 UI strings (see biggestGap) forcing user to parse dev token. Hintbar crams 3 phrases 10 uppercase 'Tab cycle · Esc back | Space capture' competing with header. Call duration 30/800 tabular correct but caption 'tabular · live duration' literal again. Horizon 5 sizes flat. Fix: see biggestGap, reduce composer to one chip primary, header subtitle to '5 threads · 11:49 AM' tabular-nums only.
gaps.edgeStates: Expected all 6 states designed but humane copy without token leaks, single illustration + one CTA: visionOS. Got all 6 verified (normal, loading 30 skeletons shimmer, empty humane 64 illu + 2 CTAs + Prism glass pill, error PR-MSG-503 danger + Retry/Dismiss + 12s retry, offline dim 0.52 blur1 + queued 2 + Retry sync, permission PR-MSG-401 + Open Settings) — strongest piece vs earlier waves — but empty caption leaks 'tabular times · 600×600', offline leaks tabular, permission note 'Colorblind-safe · no red-only signals' is dev annotation leaking, offline thread tap does nothing silent (line 820 early return). VisionOS still more refined spacing. Score 7 vs 9.
gaps.dependability: Expected any crash lands safe recoverable no dead ends: visionOS always banner + fallback. Got generally safe: empty New message -> openConversation mara + banner, error Retry -> skeleton -> banner Messages restored, offline Retry sync -> 'Still offline' banner safe, permission Open Settings -> 'Permission granted' banner, call end -> 'Call ended · 00:XX · tabular' + banner safe landing, composer chip tap always sends + auto-reply after 900ms + banner Sent. Gap: offline threads are visible but click when edgeState offline returns early with no banner (line 820 `if(edgeState!=='normal') return;`) so tap on Mara while offline does nothing — silent dead end vs expected banner 'Offline · call queued' (startCall does banner but openConversation does not). Also composer field is div not input so keyboard typing dead end. Horizon has more dead ends. Score 6 vs 9.
gaps.accessibility: Expected 44px min targets, AA contrast, reduced-motion, colorblind-safe, single focus order: visionOS 44-56, 2.5px focus ring, mono audio. Got unlabeled 0 good, reducedMotion true via @media, subTen 0, lowAlpha 0 per probe, but hit targets fail: .thread-call 30px (226-233) <44, .reply-chip 28h (393-401) <44, hintbar 10px uppercase at bottom competes but low contrast 0.42 metadata; tab order 20 foci requires ~10 Tabs to reach composer after bubbles (each bubble row is focusable) — excessive stops. Colorblind: blue badge vs red call end distinguishable by shape + size but still red/green for presence dot vs warn. Contrast thread-delivered ink-40 0.42 borderline AA on glass. VisionOS passes all. Score 5 vs 9.
gaps.delight: Expected one earned signature moment serving function: visionOS subtle spring on message send + parallax world blur. Got multiple competing delight attempts not earned: photo bubble red gradient 112h (line 356-359) decorative not tied to 12MP metadata need, ringPulse infinite around call avatar (line 482) attention-costly, wave 7 bars jitter random every 140ms (not RMS), livePulse dot, shimmer not tied to content. None Prism-specific to monocular 20° FOV world layer (e.g., world-layer at 20° demo hint in Mara preview could be signature but not celebrated). Functional call wave is closest to earned but infinite + random defeats. Horizon flat no delight. Score 5 vs 9.
